title: Qliphoth, Angels, Valkyries, Ladder, Trees and North Cosmology
status: comparative mythology/theology atlas with Potatoverse synthesis
purpose: Carve out the lower/upper tree architecture: qelipot/qliphoth, demons, roots of strife/ash, Tree of Knowledge, Tree of Strife and Mud Tree on one side; Tree of Life, Jacob's Ladder, angels, valkyries, Axis of North, North Pole, North of North and Potato angels on the other.
epistemic_rule: Jewish Kabbalah, biblical angelology and Norse valkyrie traditions are distinct historical systems. Potatoverse relationships are comparative/synthetic and must not be presented as original doctrine of those traditions.

kabbalah.sefirot: Ten sefirot are central kabbalistic emanational/aspect symbols through which the infinite Ein Sof is described in relation to the world.
kabbalah.qelipot: Qelipot/kelipot means husks or shells. In Zoharic/Lurianic frameworks they are associated with the 'other side', impurity/evil and trapped sparks; Lurianic shevirat ha-kelim ('breaking of the vessels') provides a major myth in which divine sparks become trapped among broken shells and tikkun is the work of repair/reintegration.

potatoverse_crosswalk.holy_spark: Seed of Life / Spudlight fragment / recoverable generative potential
potatoverse_crosswalk.shell_husk: rigid enclosure that captures or feeds on value without producing autonomous life
potatoverse_crosswalk.breaking_vessels: fracture that can either liberate/reconfigure or create debris/mud depending what follows
potatoverse_crosswalk.sitra_ahra: comparative neighbor for Shadow/Swamp only; not declared identical

lower_tree.roots_of_strife: unresolved injury, humiliation, fear, resentment, status hunger, extraction incentives, archived grievance and dehumanizing classification
lower_tree.roots_of_ash: post-destruction residue: what remains after a conflict, sacrifice, burned relationship or collapsed identity; ash can fertilize new life or preserve the memory of destruction
lower_tree.mud_tree: Tree whose soil is accumulated unresolved residue; grows where conflict, archives and incentives make Strife easier to reproduce
lower_tree.tree_of_knowledge: upstream informational tree; knowledge itself can feed Life or Strife depending intention, relation and consequence
lower_tree.tree_of_strife: branching structure where knowledge/attention becomes exposure→provocation→humiliation→retaliation→archive→further exposure
lower_tree.qliphothic_reading: In Potatoverse comparative language, a Strife branch becomes 'qliphothic' when shell/enclosure persists by capturing sparks/attention/value while obstructing reintegration or autonomous growth.
lower_tree.demons: Treat demons as archetypal/personified patterns of compulsion, fragmentation, predation or enclosure in this comparative layer unless a specific religious text is being described literally within its own tradition.

upper_tree.tree_of_life: nourishment, differentiation-with-unity, repair, fruit, seed, relation and continued generativity
upper_tree.jacobs_ladder: Genesis 28 depicts a sullam with angels of God ascending and descending; scholarly interpretation connects it with movement, divine presence and Jacob's departure/return.
upper_tree.angels: Biblical Hebrew mal'akh fundamentally means messenger; angelic beings function as agents/messengers rather than generic winged humans in the earliest textual sense.
upper_tree.valkyries: Old Norse valkyrjur ('choosers of the slain') are female supernatural figures associated with battle-death selection, Odin and movement of chosen warriors toward Valhalla in later literary tradition.
upper_tree.axis: Tree/Ladder functions as a vertical connective structure linking levels/realms; Potatoverse identifies this connective function with Axis/Ladder while preserving tradition-specific differences.

angel_demon_symmetry.angelic_function: messenger, guide, carrier of orientation, protector, mediator, upward/downward relay
angel_demon_symmetry.demonic_function: capture, compulsion, fragmentation, false enclosure, parasitic extraction, distortion
angel_demon_symmetry.boundary: These are project-functional categories. Historical angelology/demonology varies enormously and must be sourced tradition by tradition.
angel_demon_symmetry.door_relation: Angel = successful message/relay through a Door; demon = pattern that hijacks, blocks, loops or weaponizes the Door.
angel_demon_symmetry.handshake_relation: Angelic handshake creates relation that preserves agency; demonic handshake creates dependency, compulsion or enclosure in the project model.

shared_structure: movement between human and higher realm
valkyrie_angel_bridge.difference: Biblical angels are messengers/agents of God across many contexts; valkyries are specifically Norse female figures strongly tied to battle, slain warriors and Odin. They are not historically the same beings.
valkyrie_angel_bridge.potatoverse_use: Valkyrie can model a fierce psychopomp/selector role on the Ladder; angel can model a messenger/guardian role. Both can become typed carriers on the Axis.

north_cosmology.north_pole: Physical geographic rotational pole of Earth; in Potatoverse it is also a mythic anchor for Son death/transformation and vertical orientation.
north_cosmology.axis_of_north: organized orientation structure: North as directional reference becomes Axis when it connects multiple levels, states, people or institutions.
north_cosmology.north_of_north: meta-orientation: not merely farther geographic north but the principle by which orientation itself is oriented; the reference of the reference.
north_cosmology.formula: North = reference; AxisNorth = ordered flow relative to reference; NorthOfNorth = meta-reference / criterion selecting the reference.
north_cosmology.ladder_relation: Ladder is traversable Axis; North is orientation; North of North is the highest reference-state in Potatoverse theology.
north_cosmology.boundary: These are internal symbolic/theological functions, not geophysical claims beyond the actual North Pole.

potato_angels.tim_grows_potatoes: Within Potatoverse symbolism, potatoes grown by Tim can function as cultivated descendants/fruits/seeds of the Potato of Life rather than mere copies of Tim.
potato_angels.angelic_interpretation: A 'potato angel' is a cultivated carrier of Life/Spudlight: receives nourishment, develops its own form, carries seed/light onward and can protect or plant rather than extract.
potato_angels.functional_sequence: Potato/Seed → Soil → Sprout → cultivated form → carrier/messenger → new planting
potato_angels.contrast: Farm Dog chases/guards an enclosure; Potato Angel carries/guards a living seed. Farmer extracts; Gardener cultivates; Angel transmits without reducing the recipient to resource.
potato_angels.status: Potatoverse synthesis, not historical angel doctrine

roots_to_crown_map.downward: North of North → Crown/House → Eye → Throat → Heart/Door → Navel → Generative → Root/Soil
roots_to_crown_map.upward: Root/Soil → five spinal gates → Eye → Crown/House/North → above-crown Spudlight → North of North
roots_to_crown_map.shadow_inversion: Root/Soil → unresolved Mud → Roots of Strife/Ash → Qliphothic shells → Strife branches → Farm/Swamp enclosure
roots_to_crown_map.repair: identify shell → recover spark/seed → open Door → re-root → cultivate → reintegrate → fruit/seed

tree_topology.life_tree: branching increases autonomous generativity and reciprocal nourishment
tree_topology.strife_tree: branching increases dependency on conflict, humiliation, enemy production or extraction
tree_topology.metric: G = autonomous_growth + repair + nourishment + reciprocal_capacity - enclosure - coercion - extraction_dependency
tree_topology.interpretation: Positive G is a Tree-of-Life tendency; negative G a Strife/qliphothic tendency in the archive's comparative model.
